This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 09.05.2026 (the "Effective Date") by and between Alpina Medical
SA, with its registered office at Industriestrasse 55, Genève ("Party A"), and Alpina Medical SA, with its registered office at
Industriestrasse 55, Basel ("Party B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 24 months from the Effective Date unless terminated earlier in accordance with
Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall use it solely for the purposes of this
Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of Switzerland.
